# structure

> Effect-based TypeScript framework monorepo for agent-focused backend software. Bun workspaces; packages import as `@structure-ai/<name>` via workspace references. Every package: `src/index.ts` is the public API, `README.md` documents it, `test/` shows working usage.

## Packages

- [@structure-ai/config](packages/config/README.md): settings DSL (Settings.string/int/port/url/duration/secret/literal/optional/struct/nested), load() with precedence overrides→env→file→dotenv→defaults, all-errors-at-once ConfigLoadError, renderDocs() markdown settings table.
- [@structure-ai/observability](packages/observability/README.md): layer() for structured JSON logging + OTLP export, ServiceMeta, Correlation.within/scoped for correlation ids on logs+spans, Metrics.boundary/track for traffic-errors-latency.
- [@structure-ai/domain](packages/domain/README.md): EntityId.define branded ids, ValueObject.define schema values, Aggregate.define decider (initial/decide/evolve) + rehydrate/execute, DomainEvent.define, EventMetadata/Envelope, Repository port, errors InvariantViolation/NotFound/ConcurrencyConflict/ValidationFailed with FailureClass.
- [@structure-ai/cqrs](packages/cqrs/README.md): Command.define/Query.define with Schema payload+success, CommandBus/QueryBus dispatch with validation, Authorizer hook, IdempotencyStore, timeouts, spans+metrics per dispatch.
- [@structure-ai/authorization](packages/authorization/README.md): Policy.define typed resources×actions→permissions with roles (inherits, `res:*`/`*` wildcards, conditional grants via Condition.owner/sameTenant/…, scoped role assignments), Principal.within fiber propagation, policy.decide/can/check/require + toMarkdown matrix, Authorization service layer, CqrsAuthorization.rules → bus Authorizer layer (deny unmapped), HttpAuthorization.layer/fromBearer/requirePermission, errors Unauthenticated(401)/PermissionDenied(403)/InvalidPolicy.
- [@structure-ai/eventsourcing](packages/eventsourcing/README.md): EventStore/SnapshotStore/CheckpointStore/Outbox/Inbox ports, EventRegistry codec with upcasters, AggregateStore (load/execute/executeWithRetry, optimistic concurrency), Projection catchup/run/rebuild, OutboxRelay with bounded retry + dead letters, in-memory layers for everything.
- [@structure-ai/eventsourcing-sqlite](packages/eventsourcing-sqlite/README.md): the same ports over bun:sqlite with transactional append + outbox.
- [@structure-ai/eventsourcing-pg](packages/eventsourcing-pg/README.md): the same ports over PostgreSQL via @effect/sql-pg.
- [@structure-ai/viewmodel](packages/viewmodel/README.md): ViewModel.define schema-defined read models (query-side ORM: typed ViewStore get/find/upsert/patch, generated table migrations via ViewModel.migration), ViewProjection.make event-driven hydration with catchup/run/rebuild.
- [@structure-ai/migrations](packages/migrations/README.md): defineMigration/makeSet ordered forward-only SQL migrations on @effect/sql Migrator (dialect-agnostic, lock-protected), run/status/layer, migrationsCommand CLI group via subpath ./cli.
- [@structure-ai/runtime](packages/runtime/README.md): Readiness service (flag + named checks), Shutdown coordinator (reverse-order bounded finalizers), AppRuntime.launch Bun entrypoint, config-invalid startup reporting.
- [@structure-ai/http](packages/http/README.md): HttpApi route/handler definitions, OpenAPI JSON + Swagger UI, /health/live|ready probes, error→response mapping without leaking internals, CQRS endpoint bridge, Bun serve with graceful shutdown.
- [@structure-ai/cli](packages/cli/README.md): defineCommand on @effect/cli, standard --log-level/--config-file flags, classified exit codes, runCli entrypoint.
- [@structure-ai/ai](packages/ai/README.md): LanguageModel layers for Anthropic/OpenAI from settings, generateText/generateObject with usage metrics, transient-only bounded retries, TestModel.layer for deterministic tests.
- [@structure-ai/mcp](packages/mcp/README.md): defineMcpServer with schema-typed tools/resources, CQRS command/query→tool bridge, stdio + HTTP transports.
- [@structure-ai/auth](packages/auth/README.md): tenant-aware password lifecycle, magic links, passkeys, Google/GitHub/X/LinkedIn OAuth, opaque sessions, Web Request handler, storage/policy/rate-limit/audit ports, in-memory test adapter; no external auth dependencies.
- [@structure-ai/auth-sqlite](packages/auth-sqlite/README.md): Bun-native SQLite AuthStore, schema migration, tenant-scoped constraints, atomic one-time consumption, password/session transactions, passkey counter compare-and-set.
- [@structure-ai/auth-pg](packages/auth-pg/README.md): Bun-native PostgreSQL implementation of the same durable AuthStore and migration contract; integration tests use DATABASE_URL.

## Documentation

- [docs/index.md](docs/index.md): documentation map + living-doc policy (what lives where, update-in-same-PR rule).
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): one app end to end across all packages.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): command flow, dependency direction, consistency model, error taxonomy.
- [docs/operations.md](docs/operations.md): startup, migrations policy, health, shutdown, telemetry alerts, recovery procedures.
- [docs/decisions/](docs/decisions/README.md): ADRs 0001-0010 — why the system is shaped this way.

## Conventions

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, package map, hard rules, dependency direction, VCS conventions (CLAUDE.md imports it).
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): contribution flow for humans and agents — issues, branches, tests-first, verification gates, PR template; CI mirrors the same gates.
- [README.md](README.md): human overview and design rules.
- Skills in `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md`: step-by-step recipes — define-settings, add-observability, wire-runtime, create-aggregate, create-command, create-event-handler, create-view-model, add-migration, integrate-contexts, wire-sql-adapters, serve-http, create-cli-command, call-llm, add-authentication, restrict-access, expose-mcp-tool, read-app-state, install (Claude Code compatibility symlink).
